facts.subject: Ravik
facts.statement: Ravik is a land-bridge neighbour that connects the eastern and western parts of the region by rail and road.

source_ref.text_snippet: Ravik is a land-bridge neighbour that connects the eastern and western parts of the region by rail and road.

facts.subject: Ravik exports
facts.statement: The main exports are rail and road transit services and wheat.

source_ref.text_snippet: The main exports are rail and road transit services and wheat.

facts.subject: Ravik imports
facts.statement: The country imports energy and manufactured goods.

source_ref.text_snippet: The country imports energy and manufactured goods.

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: Ravik Rail Link is the principal land bridge, with rail and road routes running through the capital region.

source_ref.text_snippet: Ravik Rail Link is the principal land bridge, with rail and road routes running through the capital region.

facts.subject: Vantro Trading
facts.statement: Vantro Trading, a commodity trader, is the best-known firm.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vantro Trading, a commodity trader, is the best-known firm.

facts.subject: grain-growing sector
facts.statement: The country has a grain-growing sector in the western plains.

source_ref.text_snippet: The country also has a grain-growing sector in the western plains.

facts.subject: Customs facilities
facts.statement: Customs facilities at both ends of the land bridge process transit traffic.

source_ref.text_snippet: Customs facilities at both ends of the land bridge process transit traffic.

facts.subject: Warehouses and repair yards
facts.statement: Warehouses and repair yards are clustered along the main road, with a parallel rail line for bulk goods.
